description: This file declares the Controller class within the rialto::servermanager::ipc namespace, which implements the IController interface for managing IPC clients and configurations in a server management context. It includes method declarations for creating, removing, and configuring clients, as well as setting log levels and performing pings and state changes.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Implements the IController interface to manage IPC clients and configurations, maintaining a map of clients and a mutex for thread safety.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Controller with a reference to ISessionServerAppManager.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client with specified server ID and socket.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes the client associated with the specified server ID.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with provided parameters.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Performs a ping operation to check connectivity with the server.

methods.name: performSetState
methods.description: Sets the state of the session server.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the service.
